title: OLED display: I2C wiring and text

spans.text: OLED pixels emit their own light, so no backlight is needed. An I2C SSD1306 module can show text and simple graphics with few wires.
Connect VCC and GND only to voltages supported by the module. SDA/SCL go to the board's I2C pins: A4/A5 on UNO R3; selected I2C pins on ESP32.
This sketch needs Adafruit_GFX and Adafruit_SSD1306. The address is often 0x3C, sometimes 0x3D. Platform: UNO or ESP32; verify the board's I2C pins.

spans.caption: OLED display: I2C wiring and text

spans.title: Important safety note
spans.text: Supply voltage and logic levels depend on the display module. Never connect ESP32 GPIO to 5 V.
